responsibility: This implementation module provides the Logitech-compatible pseudo-random runtime services using the host C library rand/srand interface. It seeds from microsecond-resolution time via Selective, fills byte arrays and scalar storage with random byte values, derives bounded integer/cardinal results, and converts random integer state into normalized REAL and LONGREAL results in the range 0.0 to 1.0.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Random pair: it backs the declarations in Random.def with libc rand/srand calls, time-based seeding, byte filling, bounded integer/cardinal generation, and normalized floating results.
